title: Arcane Strike
summary: Arcane Strike is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 15% chance on each hit with any weapon to increase the speed of melee attacks for 18 seconds.
extract:
Arcane Strike is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a 15% chance on each hit with any weapon to increase the speed of melee attacks for 18 seconds.
Can be sold for  500.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Venus Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.
May appear as a Circuit Tier 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, or 9 reward on a weekly rotational basis.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

History
Arcane Strike was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Strike from Little Duck for 1,500  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Strike from Father for 300  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Strike from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 5  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Strike from Ordis for 3  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 4 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Strike from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 2  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
The increase in attack speed is additive to mods like  Fury.
Also triggers on hits by ranged weapons, Warframe powers, or sentinels.
Arcane Strike also affects the attack speed of  Exalted Blade,  Hysteria,  Primal Fury, and  Blade Storm.
Affects Archmelee in Archwing missions.

Tips
Particularly effective with area effects that hit many times.
 Vauban's  Bastille
 Gauss'  Thermal Sunder, which can be subsumed to Helminth
 Saryn's  Spores
 Equinox's  Mend & Maim while she is in day form
 Titania's  Razorwing
 Torid
